scripts.dev:services: concurrently -k -n api,worker -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/worker"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/worker && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/worker && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
